name: Quantumsphere Acquisition Corp. Units
summary: Quantumsphere Acquisition Corp. Units (QUMSU) is a Special Purpose Acquisition Company (SPAC) established in the Cayman Islands in 2024. Operating as a "blank check" entity, its primary objective is to seek out and merge with an existing operating business. This target company is anticipated to have an enterprise value ranging from approximately $180 million to $1 billion. Each unit of QUMSU consists of one ordinary share, along with a right that grants the holder one-seventh (1/7) of an additional share once a business combination is successfully completed.
